topic: What would happen if every volcano erupted at once?

scenario.title: What If EVERY VOLCANO ERUPTED AT ONCE?
scenario.clickbait_title: EVERY VOLCANO ERUPTS?! NOT LAVA YOU FEAR...
scenario.thumbnail_concept: A single, massive volcanic eruption plume dominates the vertical frame, with a recognizable city skyline partially obscured by falling ash in the foreground, lit by an ominous red glow. The sun is completely hidden. High contrast, instantly readable.
scenario.seo_description: What if every volcano erupted at once? The answer isn't what you expect. From instant darkness to a silent ice age, discover the terrifying truth of global volcanic eruption. Could humanity survive this ultimate catastrophe?

scenes.narration: Suddenly, the sun vanishes. Ash chokes the air, turning day into eternal night. Temperatures plummet. You can't see your hand. You have minutes.
scenes.visual_prompt: A desolate, dark city street at midday, but completely engulfed by an impossibly thick, black volcanic ash cloud. Visibility is near zero, with streetlights barely piercing the gloom. Debris like small rocks and ash continuously rains down. Cinematic lighting, dramatic atmosphere, 8K detail, photorealistic, vertical composition. Camera pushes slowly forward through the suffocating ash.
scenes.twist_element: The sudden, complete darkness and rapid temperature drop, with the implied threat of being unable to see or breathe.

scenes.narration: But that's not the worst part. Global earthquakes tear cities apart. Every ocean boils, raining acid. Rivers of lava consume continents. Where do you run?
scenes.visual_prompt: An extreme close-up of the ground violently ripping open, revealing glowing red magma beneath a massive fissure. Toxic gases and steam erupt fiercely. In the background, buildings are collapsing from violent seismic activity. The air is thick with ash and acid rain. Cinematic lighting, dramatic atmosphere, 8K detail, photorealistic, vertical composition. Ground continuously cracks and shifts.
scenes.twist_element: The escalation from ash to global earthquakes, boiling oceans, and continental lava flows, ending with an unanswerable question.

scenes.narration: Roli here. I’ve seen this. The ash blocks the sun for years. Not fire. Earth becomes a frozen tomb. The ice age comes.
scenes.visual_prompt: Roli, the photorealistic anthropomorphic rabbit scientist, in a worn brass-and-leather steampunk spacesuit with goggles on his forehead, amber eyes, stands on a desolate, ash-covered, icy wasteland. A massive, snow-capped volcano glows faintly in the far distance, still spewing a plume. Roli holds a glowing blue pocket-watch, looking calmly but eerily at the camera. Cinematic lighting, dramatic atmosphere, 8K detail, photorealistic, vertical composition. Slow, continuous pan across the bleak, frozen landscape.
scenes.twist_element: The revelation that the ash causes a multi-year nuclear winter leading to a global ice age, an even worse fate than the immediate destruction.

scenes.narration: Oceans are solid ice. Humanity hides deep, without light, without warmth. Just suffocating darkness. Until, suddenly, the sun vanishes.
scenes.visual_prompt: A breathtaking, wide shot of Earth from orbit, almost entirely covered in thick white ice and grey volcanic ash clouds. The sun is completely obscured. Faint, desperate pinpricks of light from deep underground bunkers are barely visible. Cinematic lighting, dramatic atmosphere, 8K detail, photorealistic, vertical composition. Slow, continuous rotation of the frozen planet.
scenes.twist_element: The cyclical nature of the catastrophe, looping back to the initial event and prompting a re-watch.
